title: Active Tags 1.0 — Job Configuration Schema v1 (Configuration Only)

version.description: Contract version. Must be 1 for this schema.

defaults.description: Optional contract-level defaults merged into job.activeConf at lowest precedence. (Structural validation only.)

jobs.description: Dictionary of job config entries. Keys are referenced by HTML via data-config-at="<jobKey>".

pipelines.description: Optional pipeline library. Stacks may reference pipelines by name, or define pipelines inline.

archetypes.description: Optional archetype registry. Jobs may reference archetypes by name. Resolution is runtime-defined.

IdToken.description: Identifier token used for job keys, stack names, pipeline names, etc.

JobSpec.description: A single job configuration entry (creation-only snapshot).

name.description: Optional user-facing friendly name. (System id is generated elsewhere.)

selector.description: Optional selector for self-validation / documentation. Binding is still primarily via data-config-at.

archetype.description: Optional archetype name. Defaulting (e.g., form.submit) is runtime-defined.

stacks.description: Named stack definitions used to derive job.stackDefs (creation-only).

intervals.description: Optional named interval definitions used to derive job.intervalDefs (creation-only).

pipelines.description: Optional per-job pipeline library (in addition to top-level pipelines).

StackDef.description: Defines one named stack. This is configuration-time only; execution semantics are out of scope.

pipeline.description: Pipeline selection: either reference a named pipeline, or define an inline pipeline array.

interval.description: Optional interval selection for this stack: either reference a named interval, or define inline.

PipelineRefOrInline.description: Either a pipeline name (IdToken) or an inline pipeline array.

PipelineDef.description: Named pipeline definition. Pipeline callable behavior is out of scope; only structure is validated.

PipelineInline.description: Ordered list of pipeline items (callable references with optional params).

PipelineItem.description: A pipeline item can be a string shorthand or an object form.

params.description: Optional parameters passed to the callable. (Structure is intentionally open.)

IntervalRefOrInline.description: Either a named interval reference or an inline interval definition.

IntervalDef.description: Interval definition used to derive job.intervalDefs (creation-only).

maxRuns.description: Maximum number of executions. 0 means unlimited.

overlapPolicy.description: Behavior when a tick fires while an interval is already running.

ArchetypeDef.description: Archetype definition is runtime-defined; schema validates only that it's an object.
